create_encoder_decoder_config: create an EncoderDecoderConfig from encoder and decoder pre-trained configs using from_encoder_decoder_configs
initialize_encoder_decoder_model: initialize an EncoderDecoderModel with a given EncoderDecoderConfig instance
access_encoder_decoder_sub_configs: access encoder and decoder sub-configurations from an EncoderDecoderModel config object

load_encoder_decoder_config: load an EncoderDecoderConfig and EncoderDecoderModel from a pretrained directory
